pages.text: The rain stopped and the sun came out. Soon, everyone would go into the yard.
Duri kicked off both shoes. Duri would be first outside.
One shoe slipped under the bookcase. Duri was already looking elsewhere.
Duri ran toward the blocks. The other shoe lay by the door.
Duri ran again, to the painting table. Footprints appeared all over the classroom.
Time to go outside. The children put on shoes and stood at the door.
Duri had neither shoe. "Where are my shoes?" Duri lay down and peered under the bookcase.
Teacher Bau tapped a cubby in the shoe rack. "My shoes always go here too."
The next day, Duri put both shoes in the rack. The two toes faced forward side by side.
Time for the yard. Duri quickly put on both shoes and went out first.
